content.short: Sorare is a fantasy sports game where players buy, sell, trade, and manage a virtual team with digital player cards.
content.description: Sorare is a fantasy sports game where players buy, sell, trade, and manage a virtual team composed of digital player cards. The experience centers on assembling a squad from collectible cards, diversifying holdings, and making strategic decisions about lineups and trades. The game runs across multiple blockchains, including Ethereum, Polygon, BNB Chain, and Arbitrum, providing a multi-chain environment that expands access and liquidity for card collection and in-game management.
